finding: Authorization state must be one-use and tied to the intended account.
Real app-token validation returns null scopes.
Moderation must remove copied context as well as stored chat text.
Source redirects must retain public-address and HTTPS checks.
Spliced or invented source passages must be rejected.
Normalized text must not replace the original claim in the judgment.
Word timestamps require alignment to stored transcript text.
A ready result must remain held until voting and approval permit its reveal.
Public rendering must recheck stored source hashes and literal excerpts.
A purge during a public upload must schedule removal of the completed upload.
Replayed publication must not restore a revoked receipt.
Browser SQLite must avoid binding an empty parameter list to parameterless statements.
Dropping short numeric and platform terms loses a relevant multilingual passage.
Late result or clip publication must still require an active owned stream and eligible source.
Clip replies need their own once-only outbox kind.
The built container must include the source-tier configuration loaded by compiled code.
